welcome.title: This is part of the journey
welcome.body: Being hard on yourself doesn't make the next time easier. Let's look at it together.

what.title: What happened?
what.hint: Noticing is preparing for next time. All of it is optional.

notErased.title: A slip doesn't mean all your effort is erased
notErased.body: The thought "It's ruined anyway, so it doesn't matter now" is very common and makes a slip last longer. The truth is: your effort is still there.
notErased.total: Total days in line with your goal: {n}

compassion.title: Be kind to yourself for a minute
prompts: Put a hand on your chest. Acknowledge that you're struggling right now: "This is a hard moment."
You're not the only one going through this. Change has ups and downs for everyone.
Say to yourself what you'd say to a friend: "I can make mistakes; I'm still carrying on."
compassion.done: Being kind to yourself makes it easier to take the next step.

plan.title: Update your plan
plan.hint: How could this situation be different next time? Choose an "If… then…" plan.

done.title: Carry on
done.body: You noticed the slip, learned from it and updated your plan. That's a powerful skill.
